name: Redcap Biters
descr: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.

data.motivesAndTactics: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.text: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+2** physical damage instead.

features.name: Ankle Weights
features.text: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters' Melee range.
